Package simple.file

Class JSON

java.lang.Object
simple.file.JSON
public final class JSON extends Object
Utility class for handling JSON operations, including parsing files between CSV and JSON formats, serializing and deserializing objects, and reading and writing JSON data to and from files.

This class leverages the Jackson library for JSON parsing and generation. It provides several static methods for working with JSON in Java, such as parsing CSV files to JSON, parsing objects to JSON strings or byte arrays, reading and writing JSON data from/to files, and more.

This class includes logging at various stages of the serialization and deserialization processes to help with error tracking and debugging.

    • addNode

      public static final <T> void addNode(File file, String jsonPath, T thing)
      Adds a JsonNode to the JSON path given.

      if the parent node or index of an array does not exist then it will be regenated.

      if the parent node or index of an array does exist then it will be overwritten.

      Type Parameters:
      T - object type
      Parameters:
      file - JSON file
      jsonPath - JSON path to the desired node ("node", "node.key", "node[index]", "node.key[index]")
      thing - any object
